scripts.build:css: cd frontend && npx tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i input.css -o css/style.css --minify
scripts.build:css:dev: cd frontend && npx tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i input.css -o css/style.css
scripts.deploy: npm run build:css && rsync -avz --delete --chmod=Du=rwx,Dg=rx,Do=rx,Fu=rw,Fg=r,Fo=r -e 'ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no' frontend/ user@server:/var/www/html/
